stories.title: Wales Health Minister pledges to eliminate two-year NHS waits within months in first Senedd statement
stories.summary: Wales’s new Health Minister has pledged to eliminate two-year NHS waiting times “within months” and return the overall patient backlog to pre-pandemic levels before the end of this Senedd term. stories.title: Growing concerns for missing teenage boys in Corwen
stories.summary: A police appeal has been launched amid growing concerns for two young boys missing from the Corwen area. 14-year-old Bobby (left) and 15-year-old Thomas (right) went missing at around 9pm on 31 May.
